name: Remote Operations System
description: Unified lane picker and proof workflow for managed-app, remote-cli-agent, remote-command, remote-workbench, and k3s-deploy.

chain.step: Classify the remote intent and identify the owner
Inventory existing apps, repos, registry facts, namespaces, services, ingresses, and hosts before creating anything
Use remote-cli-agent for remote author/build/test/deploy/verify loops that need a coding agent
Use remote-workbench for structured repo/file/build/test/log/rollout actions when an action exists
Use remote-command for direct inspection, logs, kubectl, network, TLS, one-off repair, and post-deploy checks
Use k3s-deploy for standard repo/manifests/image rollout once the deployment target is known
Verify rollout, public route, TLS/body reachability, and browser/UI behavior when applicable
